value.rationale: The exact asymptotic and all finite lengths of uniquely reconstructible binary three-read spectra quantify information lost when reads are unordered. The twelve-periodic quadratic law (including threshold n=9 and exceptional n=3..8) is precise, unexpected relative to generic rationality, and useful in evaluating short-read reconstruction probability; it is not a routine single-instance table entry.
